dyadID.Description: ID number for each dyad. Same generation dyads are in range 1001-1030 and intergenerational dyads are in range 2001-2031.

pID1.Description: Participant ID of person in the left half of the video. Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

pID2.Description: Participant ID of person in the right half of the video. Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.
